**Finding: deviation (Section 22.1, ¶p0093)**

Section 22.1 as drafted permits Vendor to audit us "at any time without notice" with remote access to our systems — this hits the rule's walk-away triggers on all three material terms (frequency, notice, system access). Sections 22.2 and 22.3 are already protective (Vendor bears audit cost absent a >5% shortfall; no direct system access to unrelated data; findings are our Confidential Information), so no cost-allocation edit was needed.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: 22.1 now limits audits to once per twelve months, on 30 days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, with no remote or on-site system access — the preferred position, with 15 days' notice offered as a fallback in the comment.
